names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 11 iulie, «Sfânta Olga, Împărăteasa Rusiei», with the rank word and the title left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Ιουλίου, «Αγία Ισαπόστολος Όλγα (μετονομασθείσα Ελένη) η βασίλισσα», with the rank word, the title and the parenthesis left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 11. јул ст. ст., „Св. Јелена.“ — „Св.“ is not a rank and the bare forename is the whole of what is left; there is no by-name, no see and no toponymic in the heading to keep. **It is not the name the folder is called by**: this book gives „Јелена“ as the name and says «Olga» was hers before baptism, which is a reading for §10 and not a change a reader may make. `foldchk.py` returns `helen-the-empress`, `sr`, for the string and `sr-foldpred.mjs` predicts one other holder, the same folder, so this is the second folder on the form and the heading offers nothing whatever to break the fold with.

The bare forename, and bare because every other word the calendar prints beside it is a rank. The day line reads «Равноап. Ольги , вел. кн. Российской, во св. Крещении Елены» and name page 2634 is headed «Святая равноапостольная великая княгиня Российская Ольга»: «равноапостольная» is the `equal-to-the-apostles` the folder’s `types` already carries, «великая княгиня» is the princely rank, and «Российская» stands in the line as an attribute of that rank and not of the name, so reordering the heading into «Ольга Российская» would be a form this corpus constructed and not one the page prints. The baptismal name Елена is in the row note. `fk.mjs` returns no other holder for «олга».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 июля ст. ст. — «Равноап. Ольги , вел. кн. Российской, во св. Крещении Елены (969).»

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, and this folder’s woman: the same menologion day its Romanian, Greek and Serbian rows already keep, the same rank of equal-to-the-apostles, the same 969, which is EXACTLY the year this folder’s `dates` already carry off saint.gr. `dates` and `types` UNCHANGED. THE LINE GIVES HER BAPTISMAL NAME WHERE THE OTHER THREE CALENDARS DID NOT: «во св. Крещении Елены», in holy baptism Helen — which is the «Јелена» this folder already stores as its Serbian form and the «μετονομασθείσα Ελένη» of saint.gr’s heading, so three of the four books now say it. It is recorded here and NOT turned into a second Russian name form, a baptismal name in a genitive clause being a reading and not a form the page prints as a name. Name page 2634 heads her «Святая равноапостольная великая княгиня Российская Ольга» and lists «День памяти: 11 июля» and no other day. THE READING id2634 WAS NOT OPENED. SIX HYMNS TAKEN, four troparia and two kontakia, and the folder had three before — all three of those are the Romanian, Greek and Serbian texts and none is Russian, so these six are its first Russian ones. ONE OF THEM IS LABELLED BY THE PAGE ITSELF «Ин тропарь равноапостольной Ольги, еллинский», the Hellenic one: a Church Slavonic text the Russian calendar marks as rendering the Greek service, printed under her name among the rest. It is taken as the page prints it and the label is recorded in its citation; it is NOT the Greek apolytikion this folder already holds, which is a different text in a different language. THE DAY PRINTS SIX ENTRIES AND ONLY TWO ARE PEOPLE WHOSE OWN MEMORY IT IS. The first is «Воспоминание чуда вмц. Евфимии всехвальной, имже Православие утвердися (451)» — the remembrance of the MIRACLE of Euphemia the All-praised by which Orthodoxy was confirmed, at Chalcedon — which is a feast and not a person’s day; the woman is `euphemia-the-great-martyr`, whose venerated russian row already stands on the Julian 16 сентября and which already stores her «Евфимия Всехвальная», so the entry is refused twice over and her FOUR hymns on this page were not copied. The third is «Обретение мощей сщмч. Илариона , архиеп. Верейского (1998)», a finding of relics, likewise a feast; NO FOLDER HOLDS HIM, name page 9113 is «Сщмч. Иларион (Троицкий), архиепископ Верейский» and lists five days of which this one is labelled «(обретение мощей)», so his own memory falls outside this day and a later reader owes him the folder. The sixth is the Rzhev or Okovets and the Barkolabovo icons. AND THE DAY PAGE’S OWN HTML IS BROKEN ON THAT THIRD LINE: it prints the unresolved name-link template «⟦N:Сщмч. Иларион (Троицкий), архиепископ Верейский⟧» in the middle of the sentence, which splits the line in two for any reader of the text. That is the second such defect in this block, after «@2[Аввакума]» on the Julian 6 July, and it is the source’s and not the scrape’s.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 11 iulie — «Sfânta Olga, Împărăteasa Rusiei»

attestations.note: Her life on the same site gives the day: «Fericita Olga, numită Elena din Sfântul Botez, s-a săvârșit la 11 Iulie.» The day's line calls her împărăteasa, empress; the life calls her throughout marea doamnă, the grand lady, beside her husband the marele domn, so no office is recorded in this folder.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Ιουλίου — «Αγία Ισαπόστολος Όλγα (μετονομασθείσα Ελένη) η βασίλισσα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and it is plainly the same woman: the queen of Russia, equal to the apostles, who was renamed Helen at her baptism and died on 11 July 969. The Romanian line reads «Sfânta Olga, Împărăteasa Rusiei». She is none of the corpus's three other women of the name — of Alaska, the daughter of Nicholas II, and no other is a ruler of Rus'. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The page prints two apolytikia, both naming her, and both are taken.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 24.07.2026 (11. јул ст. ст.) — „Св. Јелена.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, with its closing full stop, which is what §4 asks for and what `srbody.mjs` now hands back. **THE DAY’S FIRST ENTRY IS REPORT-ONLY AND THE ENTRY SAYS SO ITSELF.** „Св. вел. муч. Ефимија.“ opens „Ова светитељка празнује се 16. септембра, када је и пострадала“ — this saint is celebrated on 16 September, when she also suffered — and `euphemia-the-great-martyr` already carries a **venerated** `serbian` row on that very 16 September, with „Ефимија“ stored as its `sr` form. §1 is explicit: a saint who already has a venerated `serbian` row from another day is a reading for the report and never a draft. No row, no name form, no life paragraph. **THIS BOOK HEADS HER BY HER BAPTISMAL NAME AND NOT BY THE ONE THE FOLDER IS NAMED FOR**, which is the whole difficulty of the entry and is §10’s business and not mine. The heading is „Св. Јелена.“ and the body’s first clause is „Велика кнегиња руска, пре крштења звана Олга“ — the great Russian princess, before her baptism called Olga. So the name this calendar prints is **Јелена**, Helen, and «Olga» is on this book’s account the name she bore before the font. The `display_name` «Olga of Kyiv» is therefore a form **this book contradicts**, and §10 reserves a display name to the author: it is left exactly as it stands and reported. **THE IDENTIFICATION IS NOT IN DOUBT AND IS NOT MADE ON THE NAME.** The body gives the grand princess of Rus, the wife of prince Igor, the baptism at Constantinople by the patriarch Polyeuctus, the great zealot of the Orthodox faith in Russia, and the repose in 969 — and the Romanian and Greek rows already stand on this very 11 July. **`dates` UNTOUCHED, AND THE BOOK CONFIRMS THE YEAR.** „Упокојила се 969. год.“ against the folder’s `death` 969 to 969, `traditional`; the two agree to the year, and two numbers that agree are no more a reading than two that disagree, so nothing is rewritten. `types` UNTOUCHED at `equal-to-the-apostles`: the heading’s only word before the name is „Св.“, which §5 says is not a rank and yields no type at all. **`princess` is refused**, „Велика кнегиња руска“ standing in the body and not in the heading — the same refusal as the six monks of 5 July and the soldier of 9 July, and the first of this range made against a `types` word rather than a row. **No `office`** for the same reason. No `locations`: Kyiv and Constantinople in a narrative are not coordinates. **NO NEW `related` ROWS.** Prince Igor her husband, prince Svyatoslav, and the patriarch Polyeuctus who baptised her are a husband, a son and a baptiser; `ls saints | grep -i polyeuct` and `grep -i "^igor"` turn up no man this book names, and a kinship is a reading and not a name match. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.

hymns.text: Cu aripile cunoștinței de Dumnezeu întraripându-ți mintea ta, ai zburat mai presus de făptura cea văzută, căutând pe Dumnezeu și Ziditorul a toate, și pe Acela aflându-L, naștere prin botez iarăși ai luat, îndulcindu-te de pomul vieții; neputredă petreci în veci, Olga, pururea mărită.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfintei întocmai cu Apostolii Împărătese Olga», Glas 1

english.text: Giving your mind wings with the wings of the knowledge of God, you flew above all visible creation, seeking God, the Maker of all; and having found Him you were born again by baptism, and took your delight in the tree of life. Incorrupt you abide for ever, Olga, for ever glorified.

hymns.text: Τὸ φέγγος τῆς πίστεως, εἰσδεδεγμένη λαμπρῶς, πρὸς γνῶσιν σωτήριον, τὸν σὸν λαὸν ἀσφαλῶς, ὠδήγησας ἔνδοξε. Ὅθεν ὡς ἀπαρχὴ σέ, τῷ σῷ ἔθνει ἁγίαν, μέλπομεν εὐσέβειας, Ἰσαπόστολε Ὄλγα

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε — the first of two apolytikia on the page of «Αγία Ισαπόστολος Όλγα», and it names her. The reading breaks off mid-sentence at «Ἰσαπόστολε Ὄλγα» in the page's own text, which continues «Χριστὸς γὰρ ὃν ἠγάπησ…» and is cut there; only what the page prints whole is copied

english.text: Having received the radiance of the faith in splendour, you led your people surely to saving knowledge, glorious one; and so we sing of you as the holy first-fruits of piety for your nation, Olga equal to the apostles.

hymns.text: Θείας πίστεως, αρχή αγία,αναδέδειξαι, εν τη Ρωσία, προσελθούσα του Σωτήρος τη χάριτι, και εν αυτή τον λαόν σου προσήγαγες, ως αληθής βασιλίς και θεόληπτος. Όλγα ένδοξε, Χριστόν τον Θεόν ικέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ημίν το μέγα έλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ', Θείας πίστεως — the second apolytikion on the page of «Αγία Ισαπόστολος Όλγα», and it names her; the page prints it in monotonic Greek, and it is copied as it stands

english.text: You were shown the holy beginning of the divine faith in Russia, having come to the grace of the Saviour and brought your people into it, a true queen and one seized by God. Glorious Olga, entreat Christ our God that great mercy may be given us.

hymns.text: Крилами богоразумия вперивши твой ум,/ возлетела еси превыше видимыя твари,/ взыскавши Бога и Творца всяческих,/ и, Того обретши, паки рождение Крещением прияла еси,/ древа животнаго наслаждающися, нетленна во веки пребываеши,// Ольго приснославная.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 июля ст. ст. — «Тропарь равноапостольной Ольги», глас 1

english.text: Having winged thy mind with the wings of the knowledge of God, thou didst fly up above all visible creation, seeking God the Maker of all things; and having found Him thou didst receive a second birth by baptism, and delighting in the tree of life thou abidest incorrupt for ever, O ever-glorious Olga.

hymns.text: В тебе, Богомудрая Елено, известен спасения образ бысть в Русстей стране,/ яко, приимши баню святаго Крещения, последовала еси Христу,/ творящи же и учащи, еже оставити идольскую прелесть,/ восприяти же попечение о души, вещи безсмертней,/ темже и со Ангелы радуется, равноапостольная, дух твой.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 июля ст. ст. — «Ин тропарь равноапостольной Ольги», глас 8

english.text: In thee, O Helen wise in God, the pattern of salvation was made known in the Russian land; for having received the bath of holy baptism thou didst follow Christ, doing and teaching that men should leave the delusion of idols and take up the care of the soul, a thing immortal. Wherefore thy spirit rejoices with the angels, O equal of the apostles.

hymns.text: Оставивши лесть идольскую,/ последовала еси Христу, Безсмертному Жениху, Ольго Богомудрая,/ в Егоже чертозе радующися,/ непрестанно молися/ о чтущих верою и любовию святую память твою.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 июля ст. ст. — «Ин тропарь равноапостольной Ольги (второй)», глас 4

english.text: Having left the deceit of idols thou didst follow Christ, the immortal Bridegroom, O Olga wise in God; and rejoicing in His bridal chamber, pray without ceasing for those who honour thy holy memory with faith and love.

hymns.text: Святая равноапостольная избраннице Христова, княгине Ольго,/ народ твой словесным и чистым Христовым млеком напоившая,/ молися Милостиву Богу,/ да прегрешений оставление/ подаст душам нашим.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 июля ст. ст. — «Ин тропарь равноапостольной Ольги, еллинский», глас 3

english.text: O holy chosen one of Christ, equal of the apostles, princess Olga, who gavest thy people the reasonable and pure milk of Christ to drink, pray the merciful God to grant our souls the forgiveness of our offences.

hymns.text: Воспоем днесь Благодетеля всех Бога,/ прославльшаго в России Ольгу богомудрую,/ да молитвами ея/ подаст душам нашим// грехов оставление.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 июля ст. ст. — «Кондак равноапостольной Ольги», глас 4

english.text: Let us sing today of God the Benefactor of all, who has glorified in Russia Olga wise in God, that by her prayers He may grant our souls the forgiveness of sins.

hymns.text: Явися днесь благодать всех Бога,/ прославльши в Руси Ольгу Богомудрую,/ молитвами ей, Господи,/ людем подаждь/ грехом оставление.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 июля ст. ст. — «Ин кондак равноапостольной Ольги», глас 4

english.text: Today the grace of the God of all has appeared, glorifying in Rus Olga wise in God. By her prayers, O Lord, grant Thy people the forgiveness of sins.

death.note: saint.gr heads her «Αγια Ολγα η Ισαποστολος (μετονομασθεισα Ελενη) η Βασιλισσα (; - 969)» and its narrative: «παρέδωσε την τελευταία της πνοή την 11η Ιουλίου 969 μ.Χ.». The same page dates her baptism, at which she was renamed Helen, to «το έτος 957 μ.Χ.». The Romanian source the folder was built from gave no year.
